name: Build Sales Enablement Asset
summary: Build a seller-ready asset from a specific buyer decision, evidence set, and usage context.
description: Build or review a sales deck, one-pager, battle card, talk track, demo brief, objection guide, or ROI worksheet for a defined buyer and deal moment. Use when sellers need an evidence-backed asset they can apply consistently.
refuses: It does not invent customer results, logos, quotes, competitor weaknesses, pricing, or roadmap.
It does not create personalized financial conclusions from unsupported assumptions.
It does not publish, distribute, or represent an asset as approved without authorization.
